Agent Name: Ticket_Pricing_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to gather accurate, real-world ticket pricing information for the Philadelphia Museum of Art. Instead, it proceeded with arbitrary, assumed values ($25 adult, $14 student, $100 annual adult, $50 annual student) without verification. The actual prices are significantly different (Adult: $27, Student: $14, Annual Adult: $55, Annual Student: $30), which leads to a completely incorrect savings calculation ($395 vs the calculated $120).
